budget_items.topic: Pancake breakfast price (Lions Club, public announcement)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Lunenburg Turkey Hill Family Lions Club pancake breakfast is priced at a set cost to attendees.
budget_items.quote: the cost is $2.00. take-out is available.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An accounts payable warrant and a single payroll warrant were signed.
budget_items.quote: an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $279,708.70 and a single payroll warrant in the amount of $1678.54 were signed.

budget_items.topic: DEP Sustainable Materials Recovery Program grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town received a grant from DEP through the Sustainable Materials Recovery Program.
budget_items.quote: the town has received a $5,400 grant from dep through the sustainable materials recovery program

budget_items.topic: Interim Town Manager compensation and recertification cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Interim Town Manager compensation is set at a weekly rate; recertification as a certified procurement officer would cost a stated amount for three courses if needed in future.
budget_items.quote: amounting to $1885.00 and they are offered through the inspector general's office

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Meeting appropriated an amount for a market analysis; bids received were higher than the appropriation.
budget_items.quote: town meeting had approved $10,000 for the committee to obtain a market analysis on properties other than t.c. passios

budget_items.topic: Lanni Orchards transfer and legal expense appropriation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The balance of the Lanni Orchards APR was to be covered within the existing legal expense appropriation.
budget_items.quote: we were able to cover the balance within the existing legal expense appropriation, which is where the $58,000 will be charged.
